subject: No D-RUG working group this week, schedule for the next three weeks

messages.author: 32d9070bf205b3d5
messages.subject: No D-RUG working group this week, schedule for the next three weeks
parts:
Hi all,

We had originally planned to hold our last D-RUG session of the quarter tomorrow from 10-12pm. However, with the campus response to COVID-19, we thought it would be prudent to cancel our working group tomorrow. We will hold a "virtual" working group this week instead, where we will be monitoring the Discourse site (d-rug.discourse.group) for questions during our usual working group time.

We will also take a break from D-RUG sessions for finals week and Spring break. Currently, we have our working groups scheduled to meet at the same time and location for spring quarter: Thursdays, 10-12pm, 360 Shields library. However, we will announce our schedule for Spring quarter in a couple weeks, based on best information/recommendations from the campus.

waRmly,
Taylor & The D-RUG coordinators
